تمتلكين (form VIII)
# تَمْتَلِكِينَ (tamtalikīna) /tam.ta.li.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# تُمْتَلَكِينَ (tumtalakīna) /tum.ta.la.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
